context: An explicit false flag is ignored

checklist.name: uses_changed
checklist.description: Uses `cmd.Flags().Changed("notify")` (or a Viper binding that respects it) to tell an explicit `--notify=false` from an omitted flag.

checklist.name: precedence
checklist.description: Applies the order: explicit flag, then config value, then default.

checklist.name: test_fresh_tree
checklist.description: Adds a test that builds a fresh command tree per case and covers explicit false with config true.
